messages:
anya: kicked off a quick capacity probe for the reranker+embedding flow across eu/us. goal: single-model latency SLO 50ms p95 and maximize qps per GPU.
rob: config? which dims/batches/instances?
anya: testing dims [128,256,512], batch sizes [1,4,16,64], models = rerank-small-v2 (fp16) and rerank-small-v2-int8. hw: a100 (40G), g5 / t4-equivalent, and a 32vCPU EKS node as cpu baseline in each region.
tao: include both kernel variants: default and fused-attn-kernel. add numa pin for CPU runs.
anya: yep. also probing regional network variance (eu-west, us-west). will do cold-start vs steady-state.
bench-bot: benchmark started: run_id=run-1987, shards: eu-west(3), us-west(3), metrics sink -> benchdb.
rob: early numbers from eu-west a100: dims=256 batch=16 fp16 -> 3.6k qps, p95=32ms. int8 -> 4.1k qps, p95=38ms (weird p95 increase).
tao: int8 p95 up could be kernel mismatch or quant dequant overhead on small batches. can you paste the kernel selection logs?
anya: paste: ```[runtime] kernel=matmul_v2, attn_kernel=fused_attn_v1, quant_path=perchannel_int8, batch=16, seq=128```
anya: also saw cpu baseline (32v) for dims=256 batch=16: 420 qps, p95=210ms.
rob: us-west a100 numbers: dims=256 batch=16 fp16 -> 3.2k qps p95=35ms. Slightly worse than eu-west, likely instance type mix.
tao: did you pin to single NUMA for cpu runs? cache warming?
anya: yes NUMA pinned, warmup 60s. cold-start p95s were ~2x for tiny batches. steady-state numbers above are warmed.
sre-jen: any infra anomalies during us-west run window? cloud metrics look fine, but noticed higher PCIe retry errors on one a100 host at 1987654360 — flagged.
rob: ah that could explain us-west delta. we should rerun on a different host. also kernel diff: fused_attn improved fp16 p95 by ~7% on eu-west but for int8 fused_attn slows down (dequant stage not fused).
tao: next steps: 1) rerun int8 with non-fused attn kernel to see if p95 drops, 2) run batch sweep for dims=512 at batch sizes 4/16 to assess tail, 3) capture perf counters + nvprof on suspect host.
anya: agreed. I'll queue reruns and tag bench-bot. Also creating small perf dashboard snapshot: csv snippet -> ```region,hw,model,dim,batch,qps,p95_ms
eu-west,a100,fp16,256,16,3600,32
eu-west,a100,int8,256,16,4100,38
us-west,a100,fp16,256,16,3200,35
us-west,a100,int8,256,16,4200,42```
rob: good. for capacity planning: use the warmed qps numbers minus 10% buffer and account for 1.5x burst headroom. that'll give reserved slots per shard.
tao: also recommend enabling KV prefix caching for reranker inputs — some workload had 20% repeated prefixes which would dramatically increase effective qps.
anya: noted. will add cache-on policy to the canary.
bench-bot: rerun queued: run_id=run-1987-retry-1, target hosts exclude=1987654360.
anya: thanks — will post updated table when complete. short term action items: rerun int8 w/ non-fused kernel, nvprof dump on suspect host, add prefix caching trial. :thumbsup:
rob: sounds good. ping me when final numbers land, I’ll update capacity model and cost projections.
anya: will do.
